yatzy.context: Allir fimm teningarnir eins. Fimm eins!
yatzy.note: The owner chose this take (y1) by ear on 2026-10-23: eins sounded like æns without the context; the word eins stays as written elsewhere.

great.note: The owner chose this take (g1) by ear on 2026-10-23: Vá in IPA; Egill's Vá lines are right as written.

smallStraight.context: Við teljum á íslensku: einn, tveir, þrír, fjórir, fimm.
smallStraight.note: The owner chose this take (s1) by ear on 2026-10-23: the Einn rule's seed with the counting as context, since Einn alone sounded like ein in this line.
